_about: Where raw materials lie in Crow's woods (v0.31.2). Placed once from a fixed seed, never moved or renumbered. area is one of ecology.AREAS; near pulls a node toward a point; ring sets a distance band from the clearing's centre. by_hand is kg he can take in one 20-minute session with his hands alone. regrow is kg a day; grows says in which months (1-12) it regrows. looks are what he sees, by season (winter Dec-Feb, spring Mar-May, summer Jun-Aug, autumn Sep-Nov); label is how he would name the place to himself. Crow never sees this file.

resources.label: the slick grey-brown mud by the spring

looks.any: Where the spring water spreads out, the ground is slick grey-brown mud that keeps the print of a foot and shines where it is wet.

resources.taken: Dug out about {kg} kg of the slick grey-brown mud with my hands. It is cold, heavy and smooth, and it clings to my fingers.

resources.label: the reeds at the spring

looks.winter: A stand of tall, straight, pale brown reeds rattles at the spring's edge, their tops gone to fluff.
looks.spring: New green reed shoots push up through last year's pale stalks at the spring's edge.
looks.summer: A dense stand of tall green reeds grows at the spring's edge, higher than my head.
looks.autumn: Tall reeds at the spring's edge are turning straw-coloured, with soft brown plumes.

resources.taken: Snapped and pulled about {kg} kg of reed stems at the spring. They are hollow, light and straight.

resources.label: the sandy, pebbly ground where the spring runs off

looks.any: Where the spring water runs off, it has left a fan of pale sand and small rounded pebbles.

resources.taken: Scooped up about {kg} kg of the wet sand where the spring runs off. It is gritty and runs between my fingers.

resources.label: the patch of thin wiry stems on the damp open ground

looks.winter: On the damp open ground, a patch of thin, wiry, grey-brown stems stands dead and dry, each topped with a little round husk.
looks.spring: A patch of slender blue-green shoots comes up thickly on the damp open ground.
looks.summer: A patch of slender plants with small sky-blue flowers sways on the damp open ground.
looks.autumn: A patch of thin straw-coloured stems on the damp open ground carries small round seed heads.

resources.taken: Pulled up about {kg} kg of the thin wiry stems by the roots. When one snaps, long fine strands show inside.

resources.label: the patch of stinging plants at the woodland edge

looks.winter: A patch of tall dead stems, square and grey, stands at the woodland edge where the stinging plants grew.
looks.spring: Young stinging plants come up dark green and thick at the woodland edge.
looks.summer: A dense patch of tall stinging plants, waist high, grows at the woodland edge.
looks.autumn: Tall stinging plants at the woodland edge are going brown, heavy with tiny green tassels.

resources.taken: Pulled about {kg} kg of the tall stems at the woodland edge. Where the skin is green they sting; under it lie tough, pale strands.

resources.label: the knobbly white-skinned stones at the woodland edge

looks.any: Knobbly stones with a chalky white skin lie half-buried at the woodland edge; where one has broken, the inside is black and glassy.

resources.taken: Prised out about {kg} kg of the knobbly white-skinned stones. One broke as it came free: inside it is black and glassy, and its thin edge nicked my thumb.

resources.label: the wet hollow with rusty water in the deeper woods

looks.any: In a wet hollow in the deeper woods, an oily rusty-orange film lies on the water, and lumps of brown stone sit in the mud around it.

resources.taken: Pulled about {kg} kg of the brown lumps out of the mud in the hollow. They are rough, rusty, and far heavier than ordinary stone, and they stain my hands orange.

resources.label: the green-streaked rock far out in the deeper woods

looks.any: Far out in the deeper woods, a low outcrop of grey rock is streaked and crusted with bright green.

resources.taken: Worked loose about {kg} kg of the green-crusted rock with my hands. It came away in small, sharp pieces, and slowly.

resources.label: the dark heavy pebbles in the dry stream bed far out

looks.any: Far out in the deeper woods, among the stones of a dry stream bed, lie a few dark, glossy pebbles.

resources.taken: Picked out about {kg} kg of the dark, glossy pebbles from the stream bed. They are startlingly heavy for their size.
